description: This file contains implementation of DNS record RDATA parsing and handling, including classes for various DNS record types such as SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, NSEC, and associated methods for creation, comparison, and validation.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Base class for DNS record data types with validation and comparison methods.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents SRV DNS record data, including priority, weight, port, and target.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents A DNS record data, containing IPv4 address.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents AAAA DNS record data, containing IPv6 address.

classes.name: CnameRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents CNAME DNS record data, containing canonical name.

classes.name: PtrRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents PTR DNS record data, containing domain pointer.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents TXT DNS record data, containing list of text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents NSEC DNS record data, including bitmap for DNSSEC.

methods.name: HasValidSize
methods.description: Validates the size of DNS record data based on type.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create DNS record data objects from raw data.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS record type identifier.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Compares two DNS record data objects for equality.
